'''Islander East Pipeline''' is a cancelled natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=19212|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=23229|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline was proposed to run from New Haven, Connecticut to Yaphank, Suffolk County, New York.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=23229|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=19212|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Duke Energy Corp; KeySpan<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/operations-maintenance/islander-east-applies-to-construct-pipeline-from-connecticut-to-long-island/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/islander-east-natural-gas-pipeline-project-receives-preliminary-regulatory-approval/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''260,000 Dth/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.renewableenergyworld.com/energy-business/energy-finance/islander-east-receives-final-ferc-approval/|title=renewableenergyworld.com|website=renewableenergyworld.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''50 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/islander-east-natural-gas-pipeline-project-receives-preliminary-regulatory-approval/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/operations-maintenance/islander-east-applies-to-construct-pipeline-from-connecticut-to-long-island/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/islander-east-natural-gas-pipeline-project-receives-preliminary-regulatory-approval/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Cancelled<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=19212|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=23229|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$180,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=19212|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
